shape: a small thing you fought as a kid and would welcome now, pinned to one object

slides.text: you always claimed the top bunk, leaving the floor for me; i’d love that view now

caption:
the ceiling used to be a secret only you could see
now it feels like a quiet place i still want to reach
send this to the older sibling who still saves the top bunk for you on lazy Sundays
alt: a green donkey stands presenting while a line reads about an older sibling taking the top bunk, ending with a wish to have that view now.
